name: gui_build_optimize
description: GB-2, the optimization part: the pipeline gui_build_full builds (the same steps), then every way the GUI offers to make it faster, each measured the same way -- the frame's GPU time (get_status gpu_timing, the average over the engine's 120-frame window), barriers, scopes, alias groups and passes (get_frame_plan), the Frame Plan's status line and a picture of its Logical graph with each node's GPU timing. Read only: the numbers are remembered, not required, except where a change has to show. Baseline: the bands under the Graph's nodes (GL-2b: 7 / 3 / 9 / 2 / 3 / 2 barriers), the loop's and the lighting pass's Layers, the Physical plan, Barriers, Decisions and Resources tabs; UX-6a decision 4: Add fullscreen pass gives its image no TRANSFER_SRC, so the planner aliases from the start (the bands' barrier counts are read, not required). Draw sort set to state batched in Rendering settings: saved, and the plan does not move (as many barriers, scopes and passes) -- nothing in the GUI says the setting did nothing. Features > shadow_directional > Replace with loop version: the shadow depth pass becomes shadow_cascades/0/depth, the plan keeps its size; the only way back to the folded form is Edit > Undo Render Edit. UX-6a decision 4: TRANSFER_SRC ticked on the lit image (as an image read back from outside the frame would have it) keeps it out of aliasing; the Physical plan offers Remove TRANSFER_SRC on it, and Remove takes the flag off in the graph document: as many alias groups as before, freed where it was, the bands say aliased and the picture is the same. UX-6a decision 5: the bloom body pass's Pass fields show its input's Filter, Address and mip; UX-7 decision 1 (engine RS-14): a numbered input takes sampling too, so its combos are on, and the bloom body's numbered input reads clamp_to_edge (Studio writes it with the line), not the default repeat that wrapped the bloom at the top edge. Count 3 on the bloom loop: one barrier, one scope and one pass fewer, and the zone says x3 copies. Multisampling 4 restarts the engine and the frame's GPU time goes up: the measurement does see a change when there is one. Regions (RPE11b): a project with a direct rendering config has no preset, so no region to pick. Design only (no GUI): folding several nodes, declared decisions, the equivalence mark. UX-6a decision 7: no settling wait before a gesture on the canvas's fields. Typed: as gui_build_full (without its tone map edits), and 3 in Count. UX-6b: the Frame Plan's status row and the line over the Graph canvas say the frame's GPU time and the plan's passes, barriers and alias groups; the bands say each node's GPU time; after each optimization the line beside them compares the generation before the edit with the one it made (draw sort: no change in the plan; Remove TRANSFER_SRC: the alias groups; Count 3: fewer passes), read and remembered.
